decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those specified within the application.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1070-P-001/A, 1070-P-002/A and 1070-P-003/A) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the development hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
